title: Poietic Agents
description: TLDR: Can identical agents discover and revise shared data services, shed redundant tools and skills, and use cheaper execution while preserving correct, fresh, on-time answers? Compare generalists, coherent raw/derived caching and static specialists; charge learning, communication and adaptation delays against fixed arrivals. Reviewed exploratory instrument; 47 offline checks pass. Next is bounded Haiku/Qwen/Jev qualification. No runs yet; study budget, approved credential and dedicated allocation remain launch gates.
